tests.name: T1_singleton_coincidences_excluded
tests.requirement: the 158 structurally forced coincidences contribute zero calibration evidence
tests.detail: denominator 10,654 excludes 158 forced and 200 partially forced

tests.name: T2_control_B_cannot_alter_retention
tests.requirement: CONTROL_B is a null arm only and never changes the primary population
tests.detail: 2,200 edges had a valid CONTROL_B and were still not retained

tests.name: T3_missingness_not_zero_filled
tests.requirement: NOT_MEASURED is never encoded as zero, in four explicit states
tests.detail: four states, zero-fill forbidden, both Phase-B fields covered

tests.name: T4_all_three_strata_represented
tests.requirement: every randomness stratum is present, sums to the population, and has a rule
tests.detail: {'RANDOMIZED_SUPPORT_GT10': 12816, 'FORCED_SINGLETON_SUPPORT_1': 327, 'SMALL_RANDOMIZED_SUPPORT_2_TO_10': 32} verified against the artifact, all with uncertainty rules

tests.name: T5_phase_B_remains_stopped
tests.requirement: governance locks are in force and no matrix value was read
tests.detail: all governance locks in force, no matrix values read

tests.name: T6_no_biological_outcome_fields
tests.requirement: the contract contains no correspondence result, effect size or outcome value
tests.detail: no outcome-named keys and no numeric values under one; 23 field terms scanned structurally

tests.name: T7_single_frozen_primary_view
tests.requirement: exactly one primary view is declared and classes reconcile to the population
tests.detail: single primary view V1_PRIMARY_all_retained, calibration classes reconcile

tests.name: T8_one_primary_weighting_gene_balanced
tests.requirement: exactly one primary weighting, equal to the inherited gene-balanced estimand
tests.detail: one primary (GENE_BALANCED, matching the inherited contract verbatim), promoter-equal companion barred from primary, edge-equal sensitivity retained

tests.name: T9_donors_are_sole_resampling_unit
tests.requirement: donors are the only resampling unit; promoter is block structure only
tests.detail: donor-only, nonparametric cluster bootstrap over DONORS, 4000 replicates, seed 20260929, matching the inherited contract

tests.name: T10_metacell_partition_persisted
tests.requirement: the metacell partition is written and hash-bound for Stage 4
tests.detail: partition written and hash-bound so Stage 4 reuses it by construction

note: a test is counted as real only if it passes on the actual contract AND rejects a deliberately planted violation
